name: Keep My Speakers Awake
subtitle: Keep your jack speakers ready
promotionalText: A small menu bar utility that sends periodic low-frequency signals to help compatible speakers stay awake, with automatic playback protections.
description:
Keep My Speakers Awake helps prevent compatible powered speakers from entering standby when connected to the built-in analog jack on your Mac.

A SMALL UTILITY IN YOUR MENU BAR
Turn automatic wake-up signals on or off, adjust the signal level, run a manual wake-up test and choose whether the app opens at login.

AUTOMATIC WAKE-UP SIGNALS
The app sends a short, low-frequency signal approximately every 10 minutes when playback conditions allow. It can also send a signal when an eligible jack connection is restored or you return to your Mac with Smart Mode enabled.

PLAYBACK PROTECTIONS
An active microphone, or unknown microphone activity, blocks all signals, including manual tests. Smart Mode keeps wake-ups active during detected audio playback at any Mac volume, even with the screen off or locked. It pauses automatic signals after 5 minutes of inactivity with no audio. Actual system sleep, switching user sessions or a disconnected jack also prevent playback.

DESIGNED FOR A SPECIFIC SETUP
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14.2 or later and speakers connected to the Mac’s built-in analog jack. Bluetooth, AirPlay, HDMI and USB audio interfaces are not supported wake-up outputs. Effectiveness and audibility depend on your speakers, volume and audio setup. The app cannot guarantee compatibility with every speaker’s standby system.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, advertising or analytics. The app observes system audio activity and elapsed input inactivity locally; it does not record microphone audio, keyboard input or mouse movements. Settings and bounded diagnostic logs stay on your Mac.

Available in English and French. Updates to this edition are delivered through the Mac App Store.
